definitions.name: O2A.BYKEY
definitions.body: 'BKP' BIND BKP [ 0 GET ] MAP BKP [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'BKG' BIND BKG KEYS BKG VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of [ key amount ] pairs to a Record from each key to the sum of its amounts, keys in order of first appearance

definitions.name: O2A.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'MN' BIND MS MN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS MN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty numeric Vector (mean of the two middle values when the count is even)

definitions.name: O2A.ABS
definitions.note: absolute value of a number, element-wise over a Vector

definitions.name: O2A.DIVS
definitions.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE [ 'DD' BIND DN DD DIV 'DQ' BIND DQ DQ FLOOR EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer to the ascending Vector of its positive divisors

definitions.name: O2A.ORDERS
definitions.note: JSON object String to the Vector of order Records under its "orders" key

definitions.name: O2A.LINEREV
definitions.body: 'OL' BIND OL 'price' GET 'OP' BIND OL 'qty' GET 0 OP OP NIL? SELECT MUL
definitions.note: order Record to qty times price, or 0 when it has no price

definitions.name: O2A.REVENUE
definitions.note: orders JSON String to the total of qty times price over priced orders

definitions.name: O2A.SKUQTY
definitions.body: O2A.ORDERS [ 'OQ' BIND OQ 'sku' GET OQ 'qty' GET 2 COLLECT ] MAP O2A.BYKEY
definitions.note: orders JSON String to a Record from each sku to its summed qty, in order of first appearance

definitions.name: O2A.VAR
definitions.body: 'VV' BIND VV VV G0A.MEAN SUB 'VD' BIND VD VD MUL G0A.MEAN
definitions.note: population variance of a numeric Vector

definitions.name: O2A.TITLE
definitions.note: Vector of lower-case words to one String of them capitalised and joined by single spaces

definitions.name: O2A.LWORDS
definitions.note: messy String to its Vector of lower-case words
